messages:
nina: quick heads-up: ops asked for a short runtime pin to 3.2 for the embed-serving fleet (model_group=llama-mini-quant). telemetry is showing small drift in embedding norms on runtime 3.1 when running quantized kernels. proposing a 90m pin in staging then canary.

deploy-bot: proposed action: pin runtime=3.2 scope=dedicated,hosted duration=90m requestor=nina reason='embedding norm drift on runtime 3.1 for llama-mini-quant'

rahul: question: does 3.2 change operator ordering or KV cache layout? that could affect long-context embeddings.

nina: 3.2 includes a kernel reorder for fused-gemm to fix perf, plus a tiny KV offset tweak. runtime team says model weights are compatible but numeric distribution may shift slightly.

jamie: recommend canary in ap-south-staging first (low traffic) and run embedding regression harness vs baseline. set rollback if cosine similarity drops > 0.005 on top-10 recall or >2% errors.

ops-lead: ops will only approve if we have auto-unpin. can we build that?

deploy-bot: we support auto-unpin via `/deploybot set-auto-unpin --thread=3332101111 --on-failure=true --targets=ap-south-staging`

rahul: runtime approves conditional on running the binary-level sanity tests. i've kicked off `ci/runtime-sanity --branch=3.2 --models=llama-mini-quant`. will post results.

oncall: i'll add alert rule: `rate(embedding_errors_total[5m]) > 0.02` and `avg_over_time(embedding_cosine_drop[10m]) > 0.003`. link will be posted.

docs: draft note for changelog: "Temporary routing to runtime 3.2 for llama-mini-quant embed cohort to validate quant kernel fix. Customers using low-dim indexers may see small embedding shifts; we recommend reindexing if drift exceeds thresholds." anyone want edits?

nina: please call out timeframe (90m canary + staged expansion) and rollback behavior (auto-unpin -> runtime 3.1).

deploy-bot: pending approvals: runtime,ops. command: `/deploybot approve-pin 3332101111 --approvers=runtime,ops`

rahul: runtime approval: `approved (sanity-passed)` - no infra regressions in CI.

ops-lead: ops approved for ap-south-staging only. global hold until canary metrics stable.

nina: initiating canary at 3332101200 with 3% traffic in ap-south-staging.

deploy-bot: action: pinned runtime=3.2 in ap-south-staging for model_group=llama-mini-quant. canary_traffic=3% at 3332101200

oncall: canary 10m snapshot: embedding cosine drop 0.0012, error rate +0.1%. within thresholds. see dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/embed-3.2-canary

jamie: start synthetic reindex test and top-k recall check now. will report in 20m.

rahul: CI synthetic finished: negligible difference in downstream ranking on our eval set (delta < 0.0008).

nina: 30m check: cosine drop 0.0015, errors stable. expanding to 20% traffic in ap-south-staging and 5% in eu-west-staging.

deploy-bot: action: expand canary at 3332101320 -> ap-south-staging=20% eu-west-staging=5%

oncall: alert: one host in ap-south-staging reported GPU kernel OOM during a batch spike. memory normalized after autoscale. ops investigating but not seeing user-facing errors.

ops-lead: if we see repeated OOMs, we will scale down canary. for now continue but keep 15m lookback.

jamie: 60m check: recall top-10 delta 0.0009, cosine drop avg 0.0016, errors +0.25% — still under the agreed rollback.

nina: canary passed in staging. proposing we schedule a short global unpin lift tomorrow 01:30-03:00 UTC to roll runtime 3.2 for embed-serving. any objections?

rahul: prepare a hotfix branch in case we need to revert KV offset tweak quickly. i'll open PR and tag this thread.

docs: i'll finalize changelog entry and customer advisory mentioning potential reindex recommendation and timeframe.

deploy-bot: schedule global rollout: `/deploybot schedule-rollout --ts=3332187000 --scope=global --note="runtime3-2-llama-mini-quant-rollout"` (pending ops final)

ops-lead: ops gives final nod for the proposed window. runbook ready, pager on standby.

nina: thanks all. final artifacts: changelog draft (will paste link when ready), PR for hotfix (rahul), and grafana dashboard (oncall). tagging @docs to publish after global completes. :white_check_mark:
